about: I am Thimmareddygari Harshavardhan Reddy, a final-year Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) student in Computer Science and Engineering at Geethanjali Institute of Science & Technology (GIST, affiliated to JNTU Anantapur), Nellore, graduating in 2027.

My technical journey focuses on full-stack development, backend system design, and applied artificial intelligence. I specialize in Core Java (OOP, Data Structures, Algorithms), modern frontend engineering with React.js, and robust backend APIs with Node.js, Express, and Django.

In software development, I have designed and deployed production-grade applications including VideStore (a complete fashion e-commerce platform with payment gateway integration), built Hollow (a personal expense tracker and budget analytics web application), and audited the security architecture of GRAMMPAY (eliminating authentication and fund-transfer vulnerabilities with bcrypt and JWT).

For my final-year engineering milestone, I architected AirGuard, an IoT-based hyperlocal air quality monitoring and alert system that integrates ESP32 microcontrollers, MQ135 and DHT22 sensors, a Node.js REST backend, MongoDB time-series storage, and a real-time React dashboard.

I have earned two Grade-O (Outstanding, top 10%) evaluations in structured virtual internships: an 8-week program in AWS Generative AI (AICTE-EduSkills, Cert ID: 4c27968d147486a8bce1) covering SageMaker and LLM prompt engineering, and a 10-week (120-hour) Python Full Stack Developer program (EduSkills & APSCHE, Cert No: OGQTWAOCD2OR). Additionally, I hold an Elite NPTEL Certification in Natural Language Processing from IIT Kharagpur (60%) and standardized Spoken Tutorial certifications from IIT Bombay in Java (85%) and PostgreSQL (90%).
I am seeking a Software Engineering internship or entry-level software development role. Feel free to reach out to discuss opportunities.

projects.title: AirGuard — IoT Hyperlocal Air Quality Monitoring System
projects.tag: IoT & Cloud Telemetry · Final Year Project · 2026
projects.description: Engineered an end-to-end environmental telemetry system combining ESP32 microcontrollers, MQ135 hazardous gas sensors, and DHT22 temperature/humidity modules. Designed a high-throughput Node.js/Express REST API that ingests continuous sensor packets, persists time-series logs in MongoDB Atlas, and renders real-time AQI dials, moving averages, and hazardous threshold alerts on an interactive React dashboard.

projects.title: VideStore — Full-Stack Fashion E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: Built and deployed a production e-commerce store with a multi-filter product catalog across 8 categories, persistent shopping cart, wishlist, and real-time order tracking. Engineered dual payment gateway integrations (Razorpay and Stripe), Cloudinary image storage, JWT role-based authentication for customers and admins, and a full management dashboard for inventory and order fulfillment.

projects.title: GRAMMPAY — Banking Dashboard Security Rebuild
projects.description: Audited a fintech banking dashboard prototype, identified two critical vulnerabilities (plaintext credential exposure and an unvalidated fund-transfer endpoint), and re-engineered the application's authentication layer. Implemented salted bcrypt password hashing, stateless JWT session tokens, PIN lockout thresholds, and strictly authorized API middleware across all sensitive balance transactions.
